### Arguing with a Donkey
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-july-14-2009-11605919.html
Passage: Numbers 22:31
Points:
- Balaam set out on a journey that directly opposed God's will.
- The donkey recognized the Angel of the Lord blocking the way, while the prophet remained blind to it.
- When the animal miraculously spoke, Balaam foolishly argued with her instead of recognizing God's hand.
- Once the Lord opened Balaam's eyes to see the drawn sword, the prophet bowed facedown in surrender.
- God works through angels and providential roadblocks to restrain believers from walking into spiritual ruin.
